title: Mariners @ Astros
summary: Mariners bring the cleaner multi-layer case, with the market, listed starter shape, standings profile, and bullpen follow-through all leaning their way at Daikin Park.
lean: Lean Mariners if the cleaner starter-to-bullpen chain and standings profile still hold once the late innings start to matter.
factors: Current board: Mariners -175 / Astros +144 | O8.5 (-122) / U8.5 (+102) | Mariners -1.5 (-105) / Astros +1.5 (-115).
Tatsuya Imai enters with the softer ERA baseline, so early traffic could flip the whole script quickly.
Mariners enter 20-22, 2nd in division, +4 RD; Astros enter 16-26, 5th in division, -36 RD.
Mariners offense: 7.52 H/G with 6.00 over the last three; Astros offense: 8.76 H/G with 5.33 over the last three.
Mariners bullpen: 3.31 ERA and 1.34 WHIP; Astros bullpen: 5.98 ERA and 1.62 WHIP.
swingFactor: Swing factor: whether Imai can keep the ball in the yard long enough to stop Daikin Park from amplifying an early mistake.
